findingDetails.title: Custom HF model dimension semantics diverge between auto-selection and startup profile resolution
findingDetails.evidence: Auto-selection persists dim 0 for a non-canonical HF model and the provider resolves its true dimension on first embed, while resolveActiveProfileDim returns 768 for every hf-local model unless an explicit dimension is set.
findingDetails.recommendation: Use one explicit unknown/provisional contract or require EMBEDDING_DIM for custom startup profiles, defer materialization, and add a cross-path custom-model test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared auto-select, provider first-embed, startup profile and factory call sites; no target writes.

adjudication.claim: A custom HF model can receive conflicting dimension metadata depending on whether startup uses auto-selection/provider or the profile resolver.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Compared canonical Nomic behavior, custom first-embed adoption and all startup profile consumers found by call-site search.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: 768 may be an intentional provisional default for all local models; unresolved because the auto-select path explicitly uses 0 for the same unknown custom dimension and no contract documents the difference.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Document 768 as the required custom-model provisional dimension and prove all store consumers delay or reconcile table materialization.
